component.name: Flicker
component.summary: A modern, fast, and safe USB bootable drive creator for Linux

description.p: Flicker is a fast, reliable, and user-friendly USB bootable drive creator designed for Linux. It allows you to write ISO images to USB drives with robust safety validations to protect your data.

ul.li: Automatic detection of removable USB storage devices
Smart safety checks, confirmation dialogs, and automatic unmounting
High-speed buffered writing with real-time speed and ETA
Optional post-write verification and resume capability
Modern GNOME-inspired interface and robust CLI mode

description.p: Official 1.0.0 Release with AppImage support and redesigned modern interface.
